spitfire.reference: A&AEE LF/HF Mk IX comparison, §2.4, §3–4 and Table II

spitfire.conditions: 7,485 lb takeoff, Merlin 66, F.S. gear, 3,000 rpm, radiators open; combat climb under test concession. Boost declines from +15.8 to +6.6 psi. Speed schedule borrowed from BS.354 and position error from BF.274.
